top_signals.title: Russia confirms new Ukraine peace talks as Melania Trump prepares to host ceasefire meeting
top_signals.summary: Russia confirmed Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi next week and signaled a possible Trump-Putin-Xi summit, raising questions over Kyiv's role in negotiations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Moscow Exchange to launch Bitcoin, Ether and USDT trading in December
top_signals.summary: Moscow Exchange plans to launch crypto trading on Dec. 1 under Russia’s new law, with annual purchase limits for non-qualified investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Waver as Election, AI Bubble Risks Weigh on Outlook
top_signals.summary: US stock futures were little changed as Americans headed to the polls on Election Day, with control of both chambers of Congress at stake and investors weighing mounting risks to the artificial intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Sugar Falls as Indian Output Data Signal Less Need to Import
top_signals.summary: Sugar slid at the open on Tuesday after data showed Indian production is running well ahead of last season following an earlier start to the harvest. Profit-taking also added to the slide.
